balls.text: Now goes short and across, David looks to cut but misses. David is reviewing for wide! No, that's gone at an acceptable height so RCB finish on 196
Goes for a wide yorker, but goes too wide!
Hat-trick of sixes! Length ball angled in from outside off, David brings out a big swing and muscles it over cow corner!
Back-to-back sixes! This is full outside off, David clears his front leg and wallops this down the ground! Lands right in front of the sight screen
Now Curran errs, bowling a juicy full toss on the stumps and David plays a nice pickup shot behind square leg and it goes all the way
Wide yorker, executed to perfection! It dips to stay under the bat with David looking to hit it down the ground
On a length outside off, David can only cut it to the point fielder
ON a length around off, he wflicks it down to long-off. They don't take the single. Just one run conceded and two wickets. Excellent penultimate over from Pathirana
Full around off, Bhuvneshwar digs it out towards mid-off. No single taken

That's chipped straight to long-on! On a length around middle and leg, Krunal can't time this as he looks to go downtown, ending up reaching in front for it and it's a harmless lofted shot in the end. Hooda this time holds on! Krunal falls for a duck
Short outside leg, and goes down leg as Krunal looks to swivel and pull. Called wide
Yorker outside leg beats Krunal's attempted whip across the line!
Pathirana starts off with a yorker around off, squeezed out to cover

This time, Patidar has to go! Pathirana goes full on leg at 146kph as Patidar backs away and looks to hit it down the ground. Slices it and the ball goes high on the off side. Curran at  cover makes no mistake. A very important innings from the RCB skipper, but it's come to an end

Khaleel responds with a wide yorker. Excellently executed, keeping it just inside the line as David looks to squeeze it out. Looks like David has asked for a review for the wide not called. But to no avail
Starts off with a bang Gets one short and wide and cuts it hard behind point. One bounce four

Jadeja takes a good diving catch at deep midwicket and that's bye-bye for Jitesh. Khaleel goes short and across him, Jitesh looks to pull, like he did in the last over, but this time picks out the fielder. Jadeja has to dive in front, and he is as safe a pair of hands as you can as for
Hurries Jitesh with a back-of-length delivery on leg. Jitesh swivels to pull but misses and cops a blow around the hips
Low full toss on the pads, Patidar squeezes it out to cover

30-ball fifty for Patidar! His first as RCB captain, and he brings it out with an exquisite shot! It's a short ball angled across, he backs away and punches this with a vertical bat over backward point
Pulled into the gap! Dug in short outside off and Jitesh gets inside the line and swats it away
Whipped behind square leg, and hard, but Ravindra does well to stop that. That was a full toss on middle and leg and Patidar will feel annoyed he couldn't get more out of that
Looks to fire in a yorker on the stumps, but messes up the line. goes down leg for a wide
Now a slower ball, dug in back of a length outside off. Patidar looks to pull but the ball stays below bat
Who says Patidar is just a spin basher? This is in the slot just outside off, Patidar steps across and heaves it clean over long-on!
Full on the pads, Jitesh tucks it to long leg
On a length outside off, Patidar flicks it uppishly to deep square leg
Inside out into the stands! Tossed up full outside off and Jitesh gets to the pitch of it and lofts it wide of mid-off!
Darted full on middle at 93kph, Patidar clears his front leg and drives it down to long-off
Short-ish and quite wide and Jitesh reaches out to cut it away to deep point
Noor fires back! Knocks him over Tossed full around leg again, Livingstone again goes for the slog sweep. He was early into this shot and loses his leg stump!

Just over the deep backward square leg fielder! Tossed up full outside leg, Livingstone backs away and slog sweeps this square on the leg side. The fielder was running to his left and leapt but to no avail
Bowls this into the pitch at 90kph, angled across Patidar, who smacks it along the carpet to long-off
Another slower bouncer deceives Livingstone as the ball stays below bat for his attempted cut. Good over from Khaleel
Khaleel goes short again, this time Livingstone pulls it away straight of deep midwicket for a brace
Short ball on middle going across him, 125.5kph, and it stays low to beat Livingstone's pull
Length ball angled across him, Patidar goes across the stumps and opens the face late to steer it to deep third
Dug in short on leg, Livingstone pulls it to deep square leg
It's a 90kph slower ball outside leg. Livingstone backed away and looked to work it leg side but goes between bat and pad. Good stop by Dhoni diving to his left
Full and wide, Patidar with another big swing but can only get an edge that goes to short third on the bounce
Jadeja goes wider, and this time it is called wide! That was well outside the line
Jadeja keeps going wide, this time beating the bat as Patidar has a swipe at it
Jadeja darts one in wide again, Patidar goes after it now and gets a thick edge past Dhoni and that ball races away
Jadeja now throws it wide to take it away from Patidar's arc. And just keeps it inside the tramlines. Patidar has a look at the umpire for a wide call, but nothing given
Patidar taking the attack to Jadeja now! Backs away to this ball on a length and slaps it away wide of long-off. That rocketed to the boundary
Patidar has middled that and how! Absolutely muscled over the square leg boundary! Gets one in the slot and puts it away
Length ball punched out to the deep point fielder

This one drops just short! Patidar looks to take on this full ball angled across that goes on with the angle, gets a thick edge. Khaleel ran in from short third and dived but it was just short of him. Patidar living on the edge right now!
Flatter and fuller around middle and off, Livingstone backs away and drives it out to the off side sweeper
On a length around middle, Middlestone punches to mid-off

This time the catch is taken! Tossed up full on middle, Kohli looks to heave it leg-side but can't clear Rachin Ravindra at deep midwicket. Kohli is frustrated, and as he should be. 31 off 30 is not a knock he'll be happy about
Patidar is dropped again! Length ball angled across, he goes inside out but miscues it. Tripathi was running in from deep cover and dives forward, but can't hold on. This was a tougher chance
Dropped a little short, Patidar cuts it away to deep point
Kohli makes room leg side and miscues this slog down the ground
Chipped down the ground and this one lands well short of the long-on fielder
Shelled! Oh my! Patidar top edges this slog sweep and skies it towards long-off. Hooda is under it and the ball just bobs out of his hands! That's a poor effort!
Oooh, that was a chance. Kohli punches this length ball wide of mid-off for a quick run. The throw is just wide. kohli was a goner if that had hit!
Tossed on a length outside off, Patidar uppishly punches it wide of mid-off for a quick run
Taps this length ball square on the off side for a quick run. Good over after a quiet one from Noor at the other end
Patidar joins in on the fun now. This is full around off and he meets it with the full face of the bat. Lovely straight drive. Long-on runs across and dives but can only deflect it onto the ropes
Full outside off, Kohli wants to go big again but gets it off the bottom half as the ball rolls to long-on. Smashes his bat onto his thigh in frustration at missing out on that one
Pathirana goes fuller now and Kohli uses those famed wrists to flick it over midwicket! Noor had no chance there and the ball races away
What a riposte from Kohli! Pathirana bangs it in short on off again and this time Kohli swivels and hooks it over the fine leg boundary
Ouch! Kohli is hurried by this Pathirana bouncer. Very well directed. Misses his pull and takes a blow on the helmet. Out comes the physio for the concussion check. But Kohli looks okay
This is what makes Patidar special. Takes on bowlers even after mistiming balls. This time, he makes room and wallops a slog sweep away over cow corner
Length over top of fourth, 94ks, cut off the splice into the grass nearby. Ball goes to cover
Slog swept along the ground, big back-lift and lots of power generated off the wrists, hit to the fielder though
Length on off, 91ks, punched to cover. No spin there
Stays leg side of the length ball and cuts to sweeper cover
Sliced in the air... and it falls safely. Deep cover ran to his diagonal right but ball landed a few metres in front. Was a full ball outside off that Patidar tried to smear over extra cover.
Back of length outside off, guided to deep third. Timeout

Middle-stump yorker is executed to perfection, Kohli plays it beautifully too. Gets the front leg to the leg side and flicks it with ball just passing the crease through backward square leg. Amazing reflexes. Bowler smiles as the batter takes the run.
Yorker slips well down leg. Let go. Dhoni takes two biggish leaps to the left and tumbles sideways to collect it low
Fullish length ball on the pads, flicked to deep fine leg. Looked like the slower one, pace not shown
Length on the hips, clipped to deep-backward square leg

Beaten on the hook, Kohli's not happy it's not called wide. No review though. Was a bumper that landed around off and went over middle and leg, the batter was in the crease and tried to go fine. Side-on replay shows it actually was a touch over head-height
Shortish ball at the ribs, tucked off the back foot through square leg
Full on middle, flicked to wide long-on

Gaikwad claims a low catch at cover, Umpire Nitin Menon has his finger on the earpiece... and signals out. Guessing the third umpire was seeing the replays somehow. Anyway, The ball hovered low and travelled quick, both hands cupped the ball in front of Gaikwad's body. Was a full ball to which Padikkal made room and drove with a flourish. Great start but cut short, don't think RCB will mind that too much though.
Backs away and launches an inside-out cover drive to a fourth-stump length ball. Ball lands halfway into the outfield and is stopped into the deep
Tucked off the pads through square leg
Kohli makes room and is followed by a 95ks length ball that skids a touch low, underedged cut goes towards cover
Touch slower, on a length and at the pads, worked through the leg side
Ooh, misses out. Shortish ball down leg, beaten on the one-knee pull. Padikkal wanted to go fine, tried playing it late
Wide on a length, 97ks, turned into a wider ball by Padikkal making room. Ball goes off the bottom of the bat through point
More risk, more reward. Long-on is in place but Padikkal dances down to a quickish length ball, heaves it over long-on. Don't think he middled it but went through with the full swing
Another sweep, this is fine. Padikkal walked across, got a touch too far inside the line but went through with the shot and got it through fine leg
Beaten on the cut. Length ball lands on middle and off and goes through fourth. Not far from the stumps
RCB continue to be proactive, Padikkal nails the slog sweep flat over forward square leg. The line is just outside off which makes the shot a touch less risky
Beats the attempted slog sweep with a length ball on fourth

Another slower one from Curran, he's got a few of them out real early. 82.7ks lol. Landed around a back of length and spun in a touch, Padikkal was early on the full-faced punch, ball lobbed to the right of the bowler. Quick single to mid-off
Down leg, the shortish ball is let go after Padikkal shaped to pull it
Slot ball lands on leg and angles into the pad, Padikkal's upper body bends and the feet are mostly upright as he flicks it behind square. Pick-up shot
Under-edges the fullish length ball outside off onto the pitch and back to the keeper. Was a slower ball that Padikkal tried to cut
Launched over point, off the bottom of the bat though, lands halfway into the outfield and plugs
Length on top of leg, tries to flick it square, inside edges it onto pad
Wicket's just fallen, but Kohli is happy to slog. It is the last over of the powerplay after all. The length ball is miscued to deep square leg. Went low off the bat

Fast-handed stumping attempt from Dhoni, sent upstairs. Didn't look like Salt lifted his toe in real time. But let's see. Replay shows the front foot was on the line as he missed the on-the-up cover drive off the length ball angling away outside off. The toe didn't lift much but it did hover, the ball was on top of fifth stump, Dhoni didn't have to move his knees, which is when his superpower is unleashed. The time between the ball being caught and swooshed onto the stumps might be 0.10 seconds or fewer, remarkable reflexes and Salt - who probably didn't lift his foot even a centimetre - has to walk back for a good, but brief, 32.
Length around off, pushed to cover for a quick single
Connects with the sweep this time. A knee-roll high full toss made it easy, races through backward square leg
Down leg again, Kohli plants the front foot in line with the ball and looks to thump the sweep. Ball beats him and pops to short fine, batter didn't know initially where it went though
Full on the pads, clipped to short fine leg
Low and full but down leg, Salt doesn't move his feet and tries to shovel it fine. Misses. Dhoni slides across to collect it
A touch short, 92ks, pulled aerially to deep midwicket
Swept like it's off a spinner, and wow, that's 83ks. Quite the change up. Was a full ball outside off that was swept along the ground to deep-mid
Slow full ball dips, lands just in front of the batter, Salt has to wait for the flick to midwicket. He smiles at the bowler
Kohli looks to go through the leg side again, doesn't connect, ball goes off the pad towards cover

Kohli's trying to take Curran on but isn't able to. He walked to the leg-side wide guideline to try but got followed by a length ball on top of is bat. Beaten on the swipe across the line, ball pops into the off side
Slower back of lengther is pulled off the sticker, in the gap through midwicket. Ball slowed down in the outfield

Doesn't carry to midwicket, Noor didn't take a step forward, just lunged low and straight to try and take it low, got yorked. Was a back of lengther angling in at the batter, Kohli happy to pull it with all his might. Likely to have spliced it
Ugly but smart whip across the line well to the right of deep midwicket to pick up two. Was a length ball around fifth, Salt went across outside off and swung across the thigh.
Length on top of middle delivered from close to the stumps, 141ks, pace off the pitch is high. Salt slides leg side last second to punch it defensively, with a straight bat, back to the bowler

Salt pulls with a stable base, that's what Kohli missed earlier. This was picked up off a shortish length and smacked flat over midwicket. Deep-backward square leg was the only fielder out. One-bounce four.
Off the hook. Single to fine leg. Back of lengther at the hip, beaten on the leg glance. Ball goes off thigh pad

Beaten on the pull. Dhoni has to leap away to get the 139ks shoulder-high ball. Was going through fifth stump, Kohli wanted to nail the pull just in front of square. The front foot was well outside the crease, the back leg lifted and swivelled down leg, so he was off balance but did not sacrifice power. Beaten comprehensively

Emphatic celebrappeal for lbw from Khaleel, he ran past the batter without looking back but it's not given. CSK review . Where did this pitch? It thought it was in line. Was a fullish length ball that zipped off the pitch that beat the whip across the line - a rarity with Kohli batting, and hit just under the knee-roll. Hawk-Eye shows it was pitching just outside leg
Another four to fine leg. Round one against spin goes to RCB. Ashwin not wanting to give room, bowls another length ball onto the pads, but it's on the outer-half,  helped away with the pull
Kohli makes room and Ashwin tries to follow him. There's a bit of room to work with but Kohli pulls it over midwicket
Another carrom ball, but this time the seam is pointing towards point. The length ball on middle turns away a bit, defended into the pitch with the straight bat
Clipped off the back foot through midwicket, crowd is delighted as Kohli will be on strike
Salt on the charge, makes room to the 96ks shortish ball - not as much of a drag-down - but still enough for Salt to cut it while backing away. Through extra cover
That's a gift to start. Short ball slips out, sits up down leg. Looked like the carrom ball and was pulled off the hips, waited and deposited over fine leg
138ks again, cramps the batter for room on the pull. Hard-length ball at the body
WIde, full, and this one's middled. Flayed over point off the front foot, clears the infield which is all that he needed to do. Khaleel smiles
Aiming square leg, going deep third. Lucky for Salt. He tried to slug the 138ks full ball on off across the line, the arc of the bat swing was from point to square leg.

Khaleel keeps Salt in check again. 138ks bumper landed on leg and zips over fourth, rose just under shoulder height. Salt shaped for the front-foot pull but crouched and yanked the bat late to let it go
Salt walks down and tries to whip the fullish ball off fourth stump, misses

Beaten on the flowing square drive. Khaleel walks close to the batter while chatting, it ends with a smile. Was a length ball, seam up, that landed on off and decked away a touch. Was going over the stumps, Salt tried to drive on top of the bounce
Another bouncer-like delivery from Krunal that Dhoni manages to pull behind for four, but that doesn't matter. RCB win against CSK in Chennai for the first time since the inaugural season!
Krunal now tosses it up very full outside off and Dhoni can't connect
Two in a row! This is in the arc again and he swings it high over deep square leg
Gets one in the slot and deposits it over deep midwicket At least Dhoni is giving the crowd something to cheer
That's almost a bouncer from Krunal outside off! Dhoni looks to swat it away but misses
Tossed full around off, Dhoni eases it through point. They don't try for a single
Another one dug in short around off and Noor misses out again. This one was almost 140kph. An Hazlewood bowls out for excellent figures of 3-21
Bouncer just outside off that beats Noor all ends up as the Afghan looks to pull it away

And Hazlewood has another! Short on leg and angled across him at 137kph, Jadeja hammers a flat pull that goes to Salt's left at deep midwicket. Salt is running across and takes his above his head. Good catch from him, and Hazlewood has a third. He's been supremely good today!
On a length outside off, Dhoni pulls it out to long-on's right for a single
Short outside off now, Dhoni stands still, stands tall and pulls it over midwicket for a one-bounce four
Dhoni goes across to a length ball and helps it fine on the leg side for a boundary that draws plenty of applause from the CSK faithful. Will help with NRR if not anything else
Tossed up full outside off, Dhoni drives to cover where Patidar lets it slip through him, they get a single
Full outside off, he hammers a drive to long-off
Dropped short and Jadeja looks to hit it big, but misses
Tossed up full outside off, Jadeja hammers it over long-on for a six
Dragged down outside leg, Jadeja swivels to pull but it goes down for a wide
Angles this across Jadeja who latches on to this length ball and cuts it away through point
Tosses this up full outside off, Dhoni eases a drive to long-off
Back of length delivery angled across him, Jadeja cuts it straight to backward point where Kohli collects and has a bit of banter with Jadeja
Jadeja teases a reverse-ramp as Hazlewood runs in, the Aussie goes short around leg and Jadeja pulls it away hard through fine leg. A boundary after a while
Driven out through cover for a single. This was full outside off and he gets it out to sweeper cover. RCB won't complain
Short around leg, Jadeja pulls it onto the ground and through square leg as they scamper for a single
Another dot! This is a full ball angled across Jadeja, who looks to steer it fine on the off side but is beaten
Hazlewood startws off with a back of length delivery on leg. Jadeja looks to whip it leg side but misses and the ball drops in front
Legbreak outside off, Dhoni prods at it and gets an inside edge onto the ground that bounces above Jitesh. He leaps and ensures there's no run
Floated full outside off, Dhoni skips down the track again and drives to cover
Full on leg, Dhoni skips out and eases it through fine leg for a couple to get off the mark. His first runs of the season!
Livingstone tossed up on middle, Dhoni meets it with the perfect forward defensive

Chipped straight to long-on! Livingstone is all smiles at getting his second wicket. This is dropped short and Ashwin looks to rock back and pull. Doesn't get enough power on it and Phil Salt takes an easy catch. It's an all-English wicket from RCB's point of view and Ashwin walks off
On a length outside off, Jadeja cuts it out to deep point
Ashwin brings out the reverse-sweep! It's full around middle and he manages to get it well over the infield. No one in the deep and the ball races away
On a length outside off, Ashwin cuts it away through backward point. They get a brace as deep point runs across to his left
Krunal slows it down to 93kph and Jadeja flicks it out in front of square
Drilled in on a length arouind middle and leg at 105kph and Jadeja misses his flick and it goes off his thigh pads towards fine leg
On a length on middle and leg, 102kph, Jadeja tucks it out fine on the leg side. They do well to run two
On a length around middle and off, Ashwin hangs back and pulls it out to deep midwicket's left
Legbreak on a length on leg, tucked out to deep midwicket
And now Jadeja gets an inside edge past the stumps as he looks to cut a length ball outside off
Tossed up full on leg, Ashwin now eases it to deep backward square with a conventional sweep
Tossed up on the stumps, Jadeja clips it out to long-on
Jadeja gets a top edge as he tries to sweep this full ball tossed up outside off. It lands well short of deep fine leg running across. He picks up two
Floated full outside off, driven out to long-off
Ashwin is greeted with a full toss on the pads which he clips out to deep backward square
Chopped on! Length ball outside off, 137kph, and Dube looks to cut and can only find the inside edge onto the stumps! CSK slump further!
Low full toss outside off and Dube hits it right back past Dayal. Kohli running across from long-on putws in a dive, but that was hit too hard for him to stop
Back of length outside off, Jadeja cuts it out to deep point
Length ball outside off, Jadeja is beaten on the cut

Absolute corker! 135kph yorker around off and Ravindra doesn't have a response! He swings for the fences but only manages an inside edge onto the pads and onto the stumps! The set batter is gone and RCB will feel ecstatic

Oh, nicely bowled again! On a length outside off, 100kph, it stays low as Dube looks to hang back and pull it into the stands. Beats him comprehensively! Just two runs off the over, including a bye. Good comeback from Suyasah after being hit for a six last over
Ooh beats him with a quick one! Full outside off at 99kph, he goes for a sweep and misses. The ball deflects towards short fine off Jitesh, allowing them a quick run
Darted on a length outside off at 98kph, Ravindra can only punch it out to backward point
Length ball, tossed up wide again. Suyash keeps it out of his arc and Dube goes across to slap it out to deep cover's right
Legbreak on a length outside off, pushed out to cover's right
Suyash tosses it up quite wide and Dube squeezes it to cover
That's a poor ball and Ravindra cashes in. Short and angled across, and he just pulls it wide of short fine leg
Full outside off, Dube looks to go inside out but can only chip it to deep cover on the bounce
On a length outside off, Ravindra pushes at it and gets it out to deep third
Full and wide, he flashes at it and gets it over the leaping point fielder. Hazlewood at deep backward point does well to run across and keep it out. Saves three runs!
Offcutter outside off, cut away on the bounce to David at point
Full outside off, Ravindra gets a quick single to mid-off
That's short on middle and off but with turn inwards, flicked to long-on
Another pull, this one's on the bounce to long-on's left. Suyash not finding his length though, a touch too short again
Another poor ball. This one's a half-tracker. Doesn't rise much, Dube has enough time to swivel fully and direct the pull to the right of short fine leg
Googly on a back of length lands around off and turns away a touch. Dube stays in the crease to defend it straight
Slot ball has been tonked over the sightscreen. Line's just outside off and it's a step-hit, lunge-hit actually. Dube's got big reach and the bat swing is smooth
Gets away with a wide short ball. Cut off the bottom of the bat to cover
Loopy and fullish on fourth, Dube backs away and drives along the ground to long-on

That's a pie but is sliced to long-on. Slow, loopy above-the-eyeline offbreak tossed up around off, Curran had to wait with a still base but might've done it for a touch too long and lost balance - he was falling over to the off side. He tried to muscle it with a low swipe across the line but got it off the bottom of the bat. Krunal runs in takes it, and throws it high. Livingstone is chuffed.
Length around off, flicked to deep midwicket
Sits up off a length, Ravindra gets his back foot across to fourth stump and the front foot goes down leg. He opens himself up to pull it through the gap at cow corner
Slow and fullish, Curran dances down and clobbers it across the line. Not middled actually, ball goes to long-on
Out-of-control chip goes well over the bowler and then rolls to long-off. Was a fullish ball around off that Ravindra tried to flick through midwicket
Much fuller but Curran tries to slap it square off the back foot. He's very late on it and Suyash gestures that the ball sped straight past him.
Driven off the back foot, fumbled at cover. Sweeper runs left to stop it. Was a length ball angling away through fourth
Wide and full, Ravindra reaches forward and uses his reach to essentially sweep it to long-off
Shortish 96ks ball on leg. Looked slow, swatted off the back foot to deep midwicket
Looked like another googly. Length on leg, worked to long-on
Googly beats the slashing cover drive. Length ball looped on fifth stump, went with the angle. Fizzed off the pitch
Length on fourth, 92ks, batter looks to push it towards cover. Inside edges it to the leg side
Lucky four, under-edged pull nutmegs Ravindra and goes past leg stump. Goes through where leg slip would've been. Was a length ball on leg that skidded a touch low
Flicks the full ball to long-on
Length ball angles into top of middle and leg, Ravindra's front foot goes well down leg to pull it to long-on
Offbreak again, length on off at 91ks, Ravindra waits and flicks it softly. It's between long-on and deep midwicket
Length on fifth, driven to sweeper cover from the top of the bounce. Was an offbreak
Length at the hips, flicked off the back foot to deep midwicket
Back of length on fifth, pulled off the bottom of the bat. On the bounce to mid-on's right
Looked like an outside edge. Was a fullish ball on fourth and Ravindra went for the off drive, got it to deep point
Length on fourth, defended towards point. Fielder swoops but that was played softly enough for the single to be on
Patted with a diagonal bat to mid-off. Touch uppish. Was a length ball just outside off
Shortish ball on fourth rises around waist-height, Ravindra tried to use the angle and pull it square, under-edged it to deep fine leg
Length around fourth, defended to cover point
Slaps the length ball on fourth to cover

Caught behind? Staggered appeals from keeper and slip. Not given, Patidar reviews rather early. Replays show Kohli was convinced. Was a length ball on fourth, just over stump height. Hooda was on his toes, the back foot was in the crease and the front just outside, and he tried to run it to third with an angled, open-faced bat despite the slip in place. Hawk-Eye reveals a brush as ball passes bat, a thin edge just under the sticker. The decision will be reversed. Cheers from the crowd after the wicket though, Dhoni-anticipation stuff?
Length on fourth, cut to deep cover. 133ks. Ravindra's cuts make straight balls look wide
Another flick, this is to deep midwicket. Off a length from the pads again
Picked off the pads, touch aerial but the flick is well to the left of mid-on. Was a length ball just over the front knee-roll
Length ball is down leg, Ravindra tries to whip it fine. Misses
Length on off, 134ks, flicked softly to midwicket
Beaten on the flick. It's that top-of-stump height again, this is off a length and hits Hooda around thigh pad
Hooda wants a single to midwicket's left but won't get it. Was a length ball on leg that he defended
Around an eight-metre length, over leg and middle, Ravindra gets leg side of the ball and runs it to deep third
Ravindra goes for another square drive, gets beaten. Was a fourth-stump length ball that rushed off the pitch, looked to have beaten him on line
Square driven with complete control. Ravindra took a small step early, the second one was a half-stride got his weight into the shot. It took the length ball in front of point
Hooda takes a chance, misses. Danced towards the fifth-stump length ball and tried to drive it on the up in one motion. But the ball looked to have moved away off the pitch and beat bat
French cut goes past leg stump. Length ball on fourth stump, Hooda tried to drive through cover. No flourish but did go at it firmly, luck was with him this time

Beaten on the cut this time. Keeper and slips chat but don't take a review. Was a length ball that was a touch wide, Hooda wound up big and flashed hard. Missed it. Chants of 'Aar Cee Bee' on for a change, it's very loud
Beaten on the flowing cover drive. 132ks outswinger at fourth stump on a length, Hooda tries to stand upright and thump it, played the wrong line
Length around fifth, punched defensively to cover
Hard length at the hips, a bit of extra bounce off the surface again, clipped through square leg

Catch it is the call... deep fine leg runs to the left, manages to settle under it... and takes it. Just 133ks on the speedometer but, again, it's quicker than it looks. Rises off a length to around rib-height, fourth-stump line, Gaikwad took on the pull from deep in the crease but got a top edge that went high. It stayed high too and Bhandage ran a few metres before taking it around waist height, to his left. Kohli leaps on Hazlewood's back, who smiles in celebration
Gaikward tries to manufacture a boundary, gets beaten. He made room for the cut but the back of lengther over the stumps beat him for bounce
Extra bounce, maybe a touch of away movement to beat the edge. Hard length, 134ks, and Gaikwad shaped to run it to third but ended up poking a touch before retracting the bat
Touch back of length on fourth, 136ks, looks to punch it towards cover. Inside edges it to midwicket

Hard-length Hazlewood gets Tripathi on the pull. His height and the energy on the ball hurries Tripathi on the pull, he was in the crease and swung across his chest, but the elbows couldn't be stretched and the ball lobbed off the splice, straight to midwicket. 136ks
Length around off, driven to the right of mid-off

Flashed over the leaping slip fielder. Was a length ball around sixth, might have moved away off the pitch, Tripathi didn't try keeping the cut down, got a top edge but it went well over the fielder who was in the air, with both hands reaching up
Square driven to deep point. Off a length and middle of the bat this time
This one swings back in, length ball landed around off and went over middle and off. Ravindra's elbows buckled inwards as he square drove to point. Hit the bat high but landed nearby
Wide on a length, shaping away at 132ks, cut off the lower-half of the bat to deep third

Quick single to short fine leg's left, fielder falls to the side and lobs the ball high, without control, to the keeper. Early call for the run kept things safe. Was a length ball on the pads that was flicked off the back foot.

Shape away to beat the bat. Lands on a length around middle and off and goes through fifth, not much footwork from Ravindra. Went searching with the hands, trying to run it to third with an open bat face. Gets beaten.
